title: EasyAuth
what: Players need a password to play. Needed when the server lets in players without a real Minecraft account.
steps: New players type /register <password> <password> the first time and /login <password> after.
If someone forgets their password, forget it for them: they register again next time they join.
Its settings are in config/EasyAuth. /auth reload reads them again.

buttons.label: Forget a player's password
buttons.warning: The player has to register again, and anyone joining with that name first gets it.
